src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_cd119_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 119th Congress's districts (its file says session 119).
rec: Supreme Court of Pennsylvania, Carter v. Chapman, Nos. 7 MM 2022 and 8 MM 2022: Justice Wecht's concurring opinion (decided 2022-02-23, opinion filed 2022-03-09) joining the adoption of the Carter Plan as the 2022 congressional plan

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2024_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2024 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2024 legislative session year.
rec: 2021 Legislative Reapportionment Commission Final Reapportionment Plan (unchanged)
Pennsylvania Legislative Reapportionment Commission: March 16, 2022, the Supreme Court unanimously affirms the Final Plan and orders it used in all forthcoming elections
The 2024 file equals the 2022 file. The court's order covers all forthcoming elections until the next reapportionment.
